1. (Currently amended) A packaging substrate comprising: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having a plurality of conductive paths formed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the conductive paths configured to provide electrical connection between an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, __wherein the stiffening microstructure is structurally distinct from the conductive paths and is not a conductive path element__.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface __and is bonded to the packaging structure at a location below the chip mounting surface__.

5. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer __and through at least a portion of an underlying core layer__.

6. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 5, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a portion of the core layer __and the stiffening microstructure is bonded to the exposed portion of the core layer__.

7. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising: an integrated circuit chip mounted on the chip mounting surface __and thermally coupled to the stiffening microstructure__.

8. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 7, wherein the stiffening microstructure __includes__ a lid.

9. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 8 further comprising: a heat transfer medium providing a thermally conductive pathway between the lid and the integrated circuit chip, __wherein the heat transfer medium is disposed between the lid and the integrated circuit chip without direct contact between the lid and the integrated circuit chip__.

10. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is a ring __and is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface or a sidewall of the opening__.

14. (Currently amended) A computing device, comprising: a memory; and a packaged semiconductor device communicatively coupled to the memory, wherein the packaged semiconductor device comprises: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure; an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and communicatively coupled to the memory through the packaging structure; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, __wherein the stiffening microstructure is structurally distinct from conductive paths in the packaging structure and is not a conductive path element__.

15. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface and a sidewall of the opening __and is bonded below the chip mounting surface__.

16. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface __and is bonded to the packaging structure at a location below the chip mounting surface__.

17. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer __and through at least a portion of an underlying core layer__.

18. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 17, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a portion of the core layer __and the stiffening microstructure is bonded to the exposed portion of the core layer__.

19. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure is one of a ring or a lid __and is bonded to the packaging structure at a location below the chip mounting surface__.
